# Design: The Kiro kit (`selecle init`)

## Overview

```
 selecle init / /init ──▶ .kiro/settings/mcp.json   "selecle": { command: selecle, args: [mcp] }
                          .kiro/steering/selecle.md  how to work next to spirits (always)
                          .kiro/hooks/selecle.json   SessionStart → selecle room
                                                     PreToolUse(write) → selecle room --guard

 the person's own Kiro ──MCP──▶ selecle mcp ──▶ .selecle/ (presence, shared log), .kiro/specs
                       ──hook──▶ selecle room          (stdout joins the context)
                       ──hook──▶ selecle room --guard  (exit 2 + stderr pauses one write)
```

## Facts checked against Kiro CLI 3.2.1 (2026-11-14)

- Workspace `.kiro/settings/mcp.json` is loaded by the default agent; a server whose command is
  `selecle` resolves to npm's `selecle.cmd` on Windows; `--trust-tools=@selecle` approves it headless.
- `.kiro/hooks/*.json` (`{ "version": "v1", "hooks": [...] }`) run in CLI V3 sessions. SessionStart
  stdin: `{ session_id, hook_event_name, cwd }`; its stdout reached the model.
- PreToolUse stdin: `{ session_id, hook_event_name, cwd, tool_name, tool_input }`, for example
  `tool_name: "fs_append"`, `tool_input.path` absolute with a lowercase drive letter. Matcher
  `write` matched it.
- A PreToolUse hook's stdout with exit 0 did **not** reach the model. Exit 2 blocked the write and
  the model quoted the stderr warning to the user and asked whether to wait. This is why the guard
  warns by pausing one write instead of printing a note.
- In a run without the hook, Kiro read the kit's steering, called `room`, saw the spirit on the file
  and asked before writing.

## Components and Interfaces

### `src/kiro/kit.js`
- `KIT_MCP`, `KIT_STEERING`, `KIT_HOOKS`; `SEANCE_SERVER`, `STEERING`, `HOOKS`, `STEERING_TASK`.
- `kitPlan(root, { force })` → `[{ file, state }]`, state ∈ create | update | ok | kept | broken.
- `installKit(root, { force })` carries the plan out (mcp.json merged by server name).
- `kitLines(plan)` for people; `kitInstalled(root)` = the séance entry is in place.

### `src/seance.js` (additions)
- `spiritsAtWork(root, now)`: latest state per spirit whose terminal is still present.
- `clashWarning(root, paths)`, `pathsOfToolCall(input)` (`path`, `file_path`, `filePath`, `paths[]`).
- `roomCommand({ args, input, cwd, env })` → `{ out, err, code }`; the guard remembers warned files per
  Kiro session in `.selecle/guard.json` (entries older than 12 hours are dropped).

### `bin/selecle.js`
- `selecle room [--guard]` and `selecle init [folder] [--force]` run before the profile and agent
  checks, so hooks are fast and print nothing extra. `room` always exits 0 except a guard pause (2).

### `src/app.js`, `src/palette.js`, `src/kiro/report.js`, `src/crypt.js`
- `/init [--force]` (host only), `/steering` (chronicler with `STEERING_TASK`), the kit's status in
  `/kiro`, and a Crypt rule for steering requests.

## Data Models

- `.selecle/guard.json`: `{ "<kiro session id>": { "at": ms, "files": ["src/app.js"] } }`.

## Error Handling

| Case | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| mcp.json is not JSON | left alone, reported "broken", `selecle init` exits 1 |
| Their own selecle.md / selecle.json | kept; `--force` replaces |
| No room opened yet | `selecle room` prints one line; the guard allows everything |
| Guard input is not JSON / has no path | exit 0, nothing printed |
| `.selecle/guard.json` cannot be written | the guard warns on every try (never silently allows) |
| Anything throws in `selecle room` | exit 0: a hook must never break Kiro |

## Testing Strategy

- `test/kiro.test.js`: kit files and formats, idempotence, merging and keeping, broken JSON, CRLF,
  `selecle room` text, the guard (pause once, per session, other files, garbage, case, Windows
  paths), the real `selecle init` / `selecle room --guard` processes, `/init`, `/steering`, `/kiro`.
- Real Kiro CLI 3.2.1 runs (tasks.md task 6).
